descriptions.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上侦测到了一处环境异常。它的大气带有我们认为与中世纪金属加工有关的各种污染的痕迹，然而我们的表面扫描却被一种理应在在机械星球上出现的奇异辐射所掩盖。

在重新校准传感器之前，我们不能指望收集到更多的数据。这是时间异常，还是其他物种被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]同化的残余物？
descriptions.en:
We have detected an environmental anomaly on [from.GetName]. Its atmosphere bears traces of the kinds of pollution we would associate with medieval metalworking, yet our surface scans are obscured by exotic radiation of a kind we would expect to see on a Machine World.

We cannot hope to gather more data before first recalibrating our sensors. Is this a temporal anomaly, or else the blighted remnants of another species assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]?

descriptions.zh: 在一个别无值得一提的星系中，有一座复杂的监测站孤零零地矗立着，它早已荒废到难以修复的程度。它在监测什么，它又为什么会聚焦在[fromfrom.GetName]中这样一个狭小的区域呢？
descriptions.en: Alone in a system devoid of other noteworthy phenomena is a sophisticated monitoring station, long since decommissioned and put beyond repair. What was it monitoring, and why was it focused on such a tightly enclosed region of [fromfrom.GetName]?

descriptions.zh: 一座属于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的信标将我们的注意力引向一座地下数据库，它深埋于行星的地下。我们建立了远程安全访问，然而解密和文件碎片整理需要花费一些时间。
descriptions.en: A beacon belonging to the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has directed our attention to a data vault, buried deep under the planet surface. We have established secure access by remote, however decryption and defragmentation of the files within will take some time.

descriptions.zh:
在机械中枢的静态残骸上插着一个东拼西凑的存储介质，它围绕着一个被严密屏蔽的核心。该档案的各个部分是在不同的时期建造的，使用的材料均来自其他星球——或许是来自被机械同化的文明？

我们可以尝试解密档案，同时探测静态屏蔽核心，试图确定它们的总体意图。
descriptions.en:
Plugged into the static remains of the Machine Nexus is a patchwork of memory storage media, surrounding a heavily shielded core. Each section of this archive was built in distinct phases, using materials sourced from other worlds - from civilizations assimilated by the Machine?

We may attempt to decrypt the archive alongside probing the static, shielded core to try and ascertain their combined purpose.
